title: Hồi âm
about: Round 19, written for the tam-tau trio of piano, cellos and violas, as the user asked ("tiếng piano chưa phù hợp, hãy chọn tiếng piano phù hợp hơn và sáng tác 1 bài mới phù hợp kiểu phối"): D minor at 72 bpm, its tune in two-bar sentences that each end on a note held three beats and a breath, so the cellos have room to answer (the sighing three-note fall F-E-D first, echoed two octaves down); a middle section a third higher over F and C/E, the piano doubling its tune in thirds and sixths where it peaks; the opening and close on the piano's rolled chords with the cellos' bass under them. Round 20 ("tôi muốn tiếng piano trầm hơn nghe giống keyboard hơn"): on tam-tau-phim, the piano darker with a Rhodes layered under it. An original tune.
